STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for goods and services contracts, sub-central authorities
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.defined_by: clause 1.4 and App B footnote *** refer to the Procurement Legislation and the Procurement intranet page
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source before spend-analyst runs.
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.vat_basis: value = value_incl_vat / 1.2 (VAT-exclusive, to compare with the rules' VAT-exclusive amounts and the spend data's Net amount)
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.source: PPN-023 table row 12 (goods, services or works to a sub-central government authority); SI-2025

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for works and concession contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source before spend-analyst runs.
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.vat_basis: value = value_incl_vat / 1.2 (VAT-exclusive, to compare with the rules' VAT-exclusive amounts and the spend data's Net amount)
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.source: PPN-023 (works contracts; concession contracts row 9); SI-2025

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for light touch contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source before spend-analyst runs.
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.vat_basis: value = value_incl_vat / 1.2 (VAT-exclusive, to compare with the rules' VAT-exclusive amounts and the spend data's Net amount)
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.source: PPN-023 row 8 (light touch contracts, other than utilities or concession); PA23-GUIDANCE para 12

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.description: 'the Threshold' / 'the relevant Threshold' where the text does not say which contract type: whichever of the three statutory thresholds applies to the contract's type
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.defined_by: clause 1.4 ('Threshold' refers to the relevant financial thresholds ...)
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.note: Not a separate figure: it means whichever of the three thresholds fits each contract's type. The spend data has no reliable contract-type field, so tests citing it stay skipped and are listed under 'skipped' with this reason.

notes: Unfilled placeholders: the heading reads 'Part []' and App A row 3 refers to 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)'.

VAT conflict: 6.15 includes 'Value Added Tax' in Total Contract Value, but App B is headed 'Total Value exclusive of VAT'. The Procurement Act thresholds are VAT-inclusive; the spend data's Net amount excludes VAT.
Statutory threshold figures are not stated anywhere in the PDF (1.4, 6.5 and App B footnote *** point to the Procurement intranet page). All four parameters are null pending the auditor's figures.

Band boundaries: App B row B2 ends 'less than £500,000' and row C starts 'Above £500,000', so exactly £500,000 is in neither row. App A rows 2/3 have the same gap at £500,000. App C row E covers 'below' and 'greater than' the Threshold, so a value exactly at the Threshold is in neither. App A row 4's band says '£2.5million or more' but its cell says 'in excess of £2.5million'.

For works and concession contracts the statutory threshold is far above £500,000, so App A row 2 ('Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000') and 7.4.2 ('above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000') describe empty bands, and App A row 3/4 and 7.4.3 can apply to below-threshold works. How App A and 7.4 interact with the works threshold is unclear.

Waiver authority conflict: 7.2.2 lets the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive except competition at their discretion, but 7.3 says 'Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception'.
7.4.1 ('for all contracts up to the Threshold') has no lower bound, while 7.2 limits exceptions to contracts over £24,999.99.
7.4.2 is garbled ('provided and an exception report') and its urgency carve-out says 'unless 7.3 applies', but 7.3 does not deal with urgency (7.2.1 does).

App C row C's circumstance is garbled ('no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken'), ends with '; or', and refers to '8 above' (clause 8, Purchasing Schemes).
App C row E concerns variations, but its approval cell requires 'an extension report'.

Clauses 5.2 and 5.2.1 are continuation items of the Transparency Code list in 5.1, not separate rules. 5.2 requires publishing every invitation to tender over £5,000, while App B row A mandates no advertising below £25,000.
'relevant board' (5.3, 7.4.2, 7.4.3, 7.5.2, App A, App C) is used throughout but not defined.
11.5.3 is garbled ('in consultation with ... or nominated officer who must ensure the contractor's status ...').
Outdated references: 1.3 lists the revoked PCR2006, and 6.11 refers to tenderers 'from other member states'.
App B advertising cells: rows B1/B2 say a contract notice 'must' be published, rows C/D say an advert 'should' be placed. App B footnote *** is not referenced by any asterisk in the table.
6.23 is a heading ('Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders') numbered as a clause. The document carries no version or date; the source-file footer is '$3inav0bz.docx'.

rules.condition: procuring a service contract with estimated value above the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: Record consideration of how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire (Social Value Act 2012 and the Social Value Policy).
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Enter into a contract only where it is covered by an existing budgetary provision in the Council-approved Budget.
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: Treat the award as a Key Decision of the Council.
rules.approver: Key Decision of the Council
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: expenditure exceeding £500 (Local Government Transparency Code 2015)
rules.required_action: Publish all expenditure over £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.
rules.verbatim_quote: Under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015, councils must publish: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for goods and/or services contracts with a value exceeding £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of every invitation to tender for goods/services contracts over £5,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: all contracts in progress or awarded
rules.required_action: Publish a register of contracts with key information (value, duration, supplier).
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: all contracts let by a service area
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board monthly in the format the Procurement Legislation requires.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: Check that every awarded supplier meets the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council’s minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold (not a Further Competition under a compliant Framework Agreement)
rules.required_action: Advertise the opportunity on the CDP before any other advertising medium (framework further competitions excepted).
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc). However, where a Further Competition is undertaken via a compliant Framework Agreement, an invitation will be sent to those providers on the Framework only and no further advertisement will be required.

rules.condition: any CDP notice
rules.required_action: Have every CDP notice approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate.
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: any contract or purchase requirement
rules.required_action: Do not split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract with estimated value above the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and receive tenders electronically via the Council's Procurement Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: any electronic tender
rules.required_action: Specify the electronic tender format in the Portal and ITT and keep tenders locked in a secure portal account until the opening time.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time
rules.required_action: Reject late tenders unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied there are exceptional circumstances and other tenders are unopened.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Have a Procurement Officer open tenders electronically, with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system.
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: all quotes and tenders
rules.required_action: Evaluate quotes and tenders against criteria notified in advance to bidders.
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: Award on the most advantageous / best value quote or tender (having regard to the Social Value Policy), not lowest price alone, unless exceptional circumstances are approved in advance.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (advance approval of exceptional circumstances)
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: exception or waiver of competition for a contract with value more than £24,999.99
rules.required_action: Except or waive competition only on the grounds in 7.2.1 (urgency, contracts outside the Procurement Legislation) or 7.2.2 (Executive Director/Chief Executive discretion), subject to the 7.4 approvals.
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: exception to competition on the discretionary ground, contract value more than £24,999.99
rules.required_action: Record in writing the reasons for an exception made at the discretion of the Executive Director and/or Chief Executive.
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: any waiver of or exception to these Rules
rules.required_action: Grant waivers/exceptions only by the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer, sought in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval of the exception.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer consult the Monitoring Officer and Executive Director, with an exception report approved by the relevant board (retrospectively only where urgency prevents prior approval).
rules.approver: S.151 Officer, consulting the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend the exception to the Executive, with an exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.
rules.approver: Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: any exception or waiver to these Rules
rules.required_action: Fully document every exception or waiver.
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: 7.5.1 be fully documented;

rules.condition: exception or waiver for a contract where competition is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Submit a written exception report with reasons, in advance, to the relevant board.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (submits); relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: any exception or waiver to these Rules
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval with a recorded statement that the circumstances are genuinely exceptional.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for waivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, consortium, etc.)
rules.required_action: Obtain and record advice confirming entitlement, coverage and compliance (8.2.1-8.2.3) before using a Purchasing Scheme.
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Produce a written procurement report documenting key decisions and steps leading to award.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (produces)
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.condition: procurement report under 9.1
rules.required_action: Keep the 9.1 report for three years.
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: all procurement procedures, regardless of value
rules.required_action: Document the progress of every procurement and keep that documentation for three years from award.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (documents)
rules.verbatim_quote: In addition to the above, the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) including ensuring sufficient information is kept to justify decisions such as communications with contractors and internal deliberations, preparation of procurement documents, any dialogue and negotiation, selection and award. Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: all purchases
rules.required_action: Hold written (including electronic) evidence of every purchase.
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: all contracts within the Appendix B bands
rules.required_action: Put the contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegate.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: contract documents sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Have Legal Services retain all sealed contract documents.
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: award of any contract
rules.required_action: Notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement of every award so it is recorded on the Council Contract Register.
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement.
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.condition: amendment of a Standard Form of Agreement
rules.required_action: Have amended contract forms approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegate.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: all contracts, where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include minimum clauses on scope, timing, quality, insurance, default, legal compliance, data, bribery cancellation and 30-day payment/subcontract terms (10.7.1-10.7.9.2).
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment for every contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Include relevant specifications/briefs/technical requirements in every contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce the delivery of those requirements.

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: Relax full indemnities only with written authorisation from the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: contract where a performance bond is required
rules.required_action: Use a Legal Services-approved bond form and include it in the Invitation to Tender.
rules.approver: Legal Services (form of bond)
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: contract within 11.2 (estimated over £500,000, works or time-bound supplies/services) where no performance bond is taken
rules.required_action: Record a written risk assessment, obtain approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property, and keep the assessment on the contract file.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: 11.4.1 undertake a risk assessment in writing; and 11.4.2 seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and 11.4.3 keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: contract whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Set and verify contractor insurance levels (incl. professional indemnity and CIS status) in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property.
rules.approver: Service Director (in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property)
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

rules.condition: the Common Seal
rules.required_action: Keep the Seal in the Monitoring Officer's custody in a safe place.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (custodian)
rules.verbatim_quote: The Common Seal of the Council (the “Seal”) shall be in the Custody of the Monitoring Officer and kept in a safe place at their discretion.

rules.condition: every affixing of the Seal
rules.required_action: Have each sealing attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or designated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: every sealing of a document
rules.required_action: Enter each sealing, consecutively numbered and signed by the attesting person, in the sealing register.
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: goods, services, works or concession contract with value above Threshold
rules.required_action: Seal the contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: documents executed on behalf of the Council not required to be under seal
rules.required_action: Sign such documents only by the Monitoring Officer or designated officer and keep a register of them.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: selection and instruction of Counsel
rules.required_action: Select and instruct Counsel only through the Monitoring Officer or nominated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value up to relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Award only under the delegated authority of the relevant Service Director (or officers nominated in writing).
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Award by the Service Director on S151 and Monitoring Officer recommendation, with a written report approved by the relevant board.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director, following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Award as a Key Decision by the Service Director with the Portfolio Holder, on recommendation, with a board-approved written report and Call-In/Forward Plan compliance.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (CallIn) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: Total Contract Value £2.5million or more
rules.required_action: Obtain Executive approval (or Executive-delegated authority, reported quarterly) before award.
rules.approver: Executive (may delegate to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below. The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.condition: Total Value exclusive of VAT above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source (no advertising mandated).
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods or services, Total Value exclusive of VAT £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources (including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible) and publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, Total Value exclusive of VAT £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources (including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible) and publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, Total Value exclusive of VAT above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Run a full competitive tender seeking at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal; advertise on the Portal with information on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal. An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: goods, services, works, concession or light touch contract, Total Value exclusive of VAT above Threshold
rules.required_action: Apply Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal; advertise on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal. An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: competition not run because the contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written Monitoring Officer approval and, where applicable, prior relevant-board approval.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation. Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: Record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process.
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme without further competition
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written Monitoring Officer approval and, where applicable, prior relevant-board approval.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is being awarded under a Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above) of a type where no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken on behalf of the Council or other public sector organisation; or Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract that provides for extension
rules.required_action: Obtain S151 Officer approval for the extension.
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension. Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract, contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer for the variation.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such a variation or where the variation is a modification permitted under the Procurement Legislation. For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract, contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain relevant-board approval following a report with Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer recommendation.
rules.approver: relevant board, on recommendation from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: individual social care / SEN placement or package awarded without competition (items a-f)
rules.required_action: Record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual's case notes.
rules.approver: Service Directors (responsible)
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: any Appendix C exemption applied to a contract with annual or total value more than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain relevant-board approval for the exempted contract.
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.
